## Review and human disposition
- [ ] The diff is bounded and contains only synthetic demonstration data.
- [ ] Tests were actually run; intentional regression failures are labeled.
- [ ] Copilot review, if approved, was requested through Reviewers or a verified native automatic policy.
- [ ] Reviewed commit and actual comments (including no findings) are recorded.
- [ ] A human assessed feedback and approved any correction.
- [ ] No merge into canonical demo checkpoints; no auto-merge.

Templates do not trigger Copilot. Issue assignment is implementation; PR review
is a separate action. Remote actions and cleanup need separate approval.
